ranges. The release includes fresh Lean verification for multilinear reconstruction, continuous jets on
the actual projector ranges, their norm bound, and the decorated composition and structural support
laws. The ordinary Taylor and counting arguments retain their proof status as stated here. The
companion Lean guide identifies the exact declarations and replay evidence.
